unreleased_commits.message:
Add GitHub custom properties support

Add a custom_properties configuration section that maps
organization-defined property names to string, array-of-string, or
null values. The map is authoritative: properties omitted from a
present map are unset.

- config: CustomPropertyValue type with YAML/JSON (un)marshaling that
  accepts strings, string arrays, and null; rejects booleans and other
  types; validates non-empty property names
- github: read /properties/values into State and add
  SetCustomProperty mutation via PATCH /properties/values
- reconcile: plan add/remove/modify changes with order-insensitive
  array comparison
- export: include custom properties in full and scoped exports
- docs: add docs/CUSTOM_PROPERTIES.md and update README,
  CONFIGURATION, EXAMPLES, GITHUB_FEATURES, HOW_IT_WORKS, and
  TROUBLESHOOTING
- add .ghrepocfg.yaml managing this repository
